cobbDouglas(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint.details: The cobb-douglas function used to compute fee-based rewards for      staking pools in a given epoch. This function does not perform      bounds checking on the inputs, but the following conditions      need to be true:         0 <= fees / totalFees <= 1         0 <= stake / totalStake <= 1         0 <= alphaNumerator / alphaDenominator <= 1

params.alphaDenominator: Denominator of `alpha` in the cobb-douglas        function.
params.alphaNumerator: Numerator of `alpha` in the cobb-douglas function.
params.fees: Fees attributed to the the staking pool.
params.stake: Stake attributed to the staking pool.
params.totalFees: Total fees collected across all pools that earned rewards.
params.totalStake: Total stake across all pools that earned rewards.

returns.rewards: Rewards owed to the staking pool.
